title: Swamp Regime Contract — Accumulation, Entanglement, Retention, Exit & Repair
purpose: Define Swamp as a system/regime produced by unresolved residue, blocked flow, recurrent activation and role entanglement. Separate Swamp from Below, Mud, Debt, Mountain, Farm, Sektur, persons and case datasets.
definition: Swamp is a regime in which unresolved material and overlapping flows accumulate enough that opacity, recurrence, extraction, role-lock, blocked correction and reactivation become self-reinforcing.

state_variables.residue_load: amount of unresolved Mud/Ash/context-poor trace retained
state_variables.recurrence_rate: frequency at which old material is reactivated into new conflict/attention
state_variables.provenance_clarity: ability to distinguish source, date, context and current status
state_variables.exit_cost: difficulty of leaving the role/system without continued penalty
state_variables.correction_permeability: ability of corrections/counterevidence to change the active state
state_variables.extraction_rate: degree to which attention/status/money/value depends on continued unresolved material
state_variables.role_lock: persistence of classification after behavior/context has changed
state_variables.cross_platform_coupling: degree to which multiple systems reactivate the same material
state_variables.repair_capacity: availability of adjudication, correction, declassification, forgetting/relevance decay and restorative pathways

qualitative_equation: SwampPressure ≈ residue_load + recurrence_rate + extraction_rate + exit_cost + role_lock + cross_platform_coupling - provenance_clarity - correction_permeability - repair_capacity
entry_conditions: provenance/context becomes blurred or selectively reused
participants or systems gain from recurrence
correction/declassification does not reliably update the live state
exit becomes costly or attention continues after attempted exit
persistence_loops: event → clip/archive → rediscovery → commentary → reaction → new event
harm/accusation → role lock → audience reward → renewed extraction
uncertainty → speculation → archive → later treatment as settled history
conflict → Mud → Swamp → lower trust → more ambiguous interpretation → more conflict
exit_paths: trace → provenance → current-status check → correction → release
role → evidence review → expiry/declassification → archive update
Swamp → drainage/flow restoration → Forge → usable knowledge
Farm incentive → friction/stopping condition → Garden-style stewardship
closed attention loop → disengagement → reduced recurrence → repair

threshold_states.pre_swamp: residue exists but remains bounded and flows/corrections still work
threshold_states.swamp: recurrence and blocked correction materially shape future behavior
threshold_states.deep_swamp: multiple coupled loops preserve unresolved material across actors/platforms/institutions
threshold_states.draining: provenance and exit mechanisms begin reducing recurrence and role-lock
threshold_states.recovered: the system can remember history without requiring renewed extraction/conflict

evidence_contract: Do not classify a real person or institution as 'Swamp' without describing the concrete system relation being analyzed.
Separate claim, corroboration, investigation, legal finding and symbolic interpretation.
Record date/currentness because Swamp is a regime state and can change.
A single dispute, secret, archive, anonymous account or harmful act is not enough by itself.
Use neutral/mechanistic variables where possible: recurrence, correction permeability, exit cost, provenance clarity, extraction dependence.

relation_to_other_operators.Mud: residue/material that may feed Swamp or become Soil
relation_to_other_operators.Debt: directional unresolved obligation within or outside Swamp
relation_to_other_operators.Farm: production/extraction process that may operate inside or outside Swamp
relation_to_other_operators.Sektur: social territory/identity ecology that may or may not be Swamp-like
relation_to_other_operators.Mountain: integrated/compressed perspective structure; can organize what Swamp mixes
relation_to_other_operators.Drain: outflow route that may clear or destructively collapse

spatial_field_mapping.swamp: Lower widening can visualize breadth of unresolved coupling/recurrence, but Swamp remains a regime measured by state variables rather than a geometric zone by default.
spatial_field_mapping.drain: Drain is an inward/capture attractor that can narrow agency/exit even while surrounding relational scope widens.
spatial_field_mapping.mud: Residue may disperse across lower sections, settle, or become Soil depending provenance/processing.
spatial_field_mapping.recovery: Draining/recovery can move toward clearer provenance, lower recurrence, improved exit and eventual return toward O/Forge/Garden.
spatial_field_mapping.firewall: Large lower radius is not itself Swamp; negative z is not itself degeneration.
